summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Mast HedgeIndex Adaptive Equities ETF (HXE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in multi-strategy alternatives. The fund is an actively managed fund that aims for long-term capital appreciation by using an adaptive macro-strategy to allocate across global equity markets. HXE was launched on Aug 21, 2026 and is issued by Mast.
